note:
The Wade household on the 1891 return, given as 'Peverill House, Lenton Road', transcribed by A. Hagues. Most of them were already in the record from 1901 at 9 Lenton Road, Fern Lodge (#183), and are bound by number so they gain 1891: Ann Wade (#2976), William Richard (#2977, 'William R.'), Mary Ann (#827, 'Mary Anne'), Ann's sister Jane Heather (#2978), and the shop assistant Mary Jane Leeke (#2979, 'Mary J. Leek', born 1858 at Hoxton, a glove and hosiery assistant there in 1901). Rosa Foster and Annie Phillips are new. The record also holds Mary Jane Leeks (#828, born 1858, a visitor at 9 Lenton Road in 1911), who is the same woman and wants merging with #2979.

The house is not settled, so the household is left unfiled naming both candidates. For Peveril House: the return, and Wright's Directory 1894-95, which prints 'Peveril house, Mrs. M. A. Wade; Miss M. A. Wade, hosier' under Peveril Drive; the record's Peveril House, Peveril Drive (#300) holds no census. For 9 Lenton Road: Wright's Directory 1898-99 prints '9 Fern lodge, Mrs. M. A. Wade; Miss M. A. Wade (hosier)' and 1910-11 'Wade Miss Mary Anne' at 9 Lenton Road, where the record files the family in 1901 and 1911. On the record's own map the two houses are about 30 m apart at the corner of Peveril Drive and Lenton Road, so this is either a move between neighbouring houses or one house under two names. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, Peverill House, Lenton Road, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 111 (Leicester Special Collections id 164617); 1898-99, page 92 (id 165268); 1910-11, page 123 (id 165799).
